maya patel: Hey team — need a short (30m) sudo window to pull a sample of prod logs and run the redaction sanity checks for a privacy request. Will only query a specific prefix: s3://prod-ingest-logs/2026-03-15/sample-uuid-42 and run a read-only psql query on analytics-prod. Link to runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/log-redaction-check. Requesting access window tomorrow 09:30-10:00 PT.

sam chen: Can you paste the exact psql query you'll run and confirm whether you'll need KMS unwrap for any files? Also pls open a quick JIRA so we have an audit ticket.

maya patel: Query is just a sample extraction, nothing that writes:```psql -h analytics-prod.redwood.internal -U readonly -d telemetry -c "\
SELECT id, created_at, payload->>'message' as msg FROM events WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15' AND payload->>'source' = 'ingest' LIMIT 1000;\
"```I'll only copy the resulting CSV to /tmp for the redaction dry-run. The S3 objects are KMS-encrypted; I will not request KMS decrypt — instead will use temporary S3 GET via the read-only role. If KMS unwrap is required we'll abort and escalate. Created JIRA: INFR-6721 (link in ticket).

sec_ops: Thanks @maya. We can approve a conditional temporary elevation for a read-only role with session recording. Conditions: 1) attach the JIRA ticket INFR-6721 2) run the query in dry-run (no downloads of raw PII) 3) session will be recorded and logs retained 90 days 4) you must use the ephemeral role `logs-sampler-readonly` and request creds via our SSO flow. We'll grant a 30-minute window. Confirm you accept these conditions and we'll schedule.

jordan lee: Quick note — make sure to run the redaction regexes in the runbook against a copy in /tmp, not the original objects. If anything looks unexpected, stop and ping this thread. Also keep results under 1000 rows.

maya patel: Ack, I accept conditions. I'll request creds via SSO at 09:29 PT and start at 09:30. Will not KMS-unwrap.

sec_ops: Approved. Granting 30m window tomorrow 09:30-10:00 PT. Session will be recorded, and audit-bot will post the session id here when created. Use this CLI to assume the ephemeral role (expires in 30m):```bash
aws sso login --profile redwood
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/logs-sampler-readonly --role-session-name maya-log-sample --duration-seconds 1800
```Do not copy raw files to personal devices.

audit-bot: Session created: sess-20260317-89ab; recording_id: rec-77c3. Linked to JIRA INFR-6721.

maya patel: Thanks all — will post results (redaction diffs) here when done. :thumbsup:
